title: 2023 Panini Select #FUT-SHO Sam Howell Washington Commanders Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2023 Panini Select trading card featuring Sam Howell of the Washington Commanders. It is part of the "Future" insert set and has the card number FUT-SHO. This original card is licensed by the National Football League (NFL) and manufactured by Panini. It is a standard-sized card in the sport of football, specifically for the 2023 season.
